The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] in [0, 1] (origin top-left). At most one of them contains a building that was constructed or demolished between the two dates. (A) [0.5490, 0.7903, 0.7090, 0.9503]
(B) [0.0862, 0.4069, 0.2462, 0.5669]
(C) [0.5131, 0.3454, 0.6731, 0.5054]
(D) No building change in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
